collection.label: Cicero: The Dream of Scipio
collection.author_name: Marcus Tullius Cicero (106-43 BCE); Bamberg manuscript of the late 10th century
collection.critical_edition: Mueller, De re publica (Teubner 1889), via Perseus
collection.search_terms: cicero somnium scipionis dream of scipio de re publica republic know that you are a god music of the spheres macrobius bamberg
collection.description: The Dream of Scipio, the end of Cicero's Republic, in which the soul is shown its home among the stars and told that it is a god; complete on a manuscript of the late 10th century.

texts.title: Cicero, The Dream of Scipio (De re publica 6.9-29)
texts.date_approx: 54-51 BCE (composition); manuscript end of the 10th century
texts.source: Bamberg, Staatsbibliothek, Msc.Class.38 fol. 1r-3r (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek IIIF) + Mueller Latin (Perseus) + C. W. Keyes English (Loeb 1928, archive.org)
texts.description: Cicero's Dream of Scipio, the closing myth of the Republic: Scipio Aemilianus sees the heavens, the music of the spheres and the smallness of the earth, and is told 'know, then, that you are a god'. Complete, on the manuscript Bamberg Msc.Class.38 (late 10th century).
